title: What's in the KNM Exam? Topics to Study for Inburgering
seoTitle: KNM Exam Topics: What to Study for Inburgering
excerpt: Work, healthcare, housing, education, history and Dutch values: here's what to expect.
description: What the KNM exam (Kennis van de Nederlandse Maatschappij) covers for Dutch civic integration, how to book it with DUO and how to prepare.
body:
The KNM exam (Kennis van de Nederlandse Maatschappij) tests your knowledge of everyday life in the Netherlands. It's part of the civic integration (inburgering) exam.

## Topics it covers

- Work and income: finding a job, contracts and the UWV
- Healthcare: the huisarts (GP), health insurance and emergencies
- Housing: renting, rules and neighbours
- Education: schools and studying
- History and politics: how the Netherlands is governed
- Dutch norms and values: equality, freedom and respect

## How the questions work

Many questions describe an everyday situation and ask what you should do or who you should contact, so understanding how Dutch institutions work matters more than memorising facts.

## How to book

You book the exam with DUO, logging in with your DigiD.

## How to prepare

- Practise questions on every topic
- Learn the main institutions: gemeente, huisarts, UWV and DUO
- Take timed mock tests

Check inburgeren.nl for the current exam format and rules. Try a free KNM mock test below, in English or in Dutch.
